title: Hanoi · Ha Giang Limestone Loop Stage
slogan: Two passes and 416 km, high point 0 m
story: Limestone drama and a route that is never casual. Out of Hà Giang and back again: 416 km, roughly 8 h in the saddle. The climbs: Quan Ba Heaven and Ma Pi Leng Pass. It tops out at about 1,500 m. The passes are the reason to go.
